_doc: Per-variant config for paper_forward_runner. Each entry becomes its own LaunchAgent + isolated data dir at data/paper_forward/<id>/. Run paper_forward_install_variants.py to (re)generate the plists. Designed for parallel execution on MacBook (V3-arm variants need Redis latest_market_data; only MacBook has it).

variants._note: tighter SHORT K thresholds — markets reward earlier-shorts on overbought stretches
looser SHORT K — fire SHORT earlier in distribution, no recent-dump requirement
earlier exit on K-momentum slowdown — locks gains faster
ride longer — only exit at extreme K — tests if exits are too early
Hedge trigger via TF hierarchy (3m+15m AND ≥1 of 1h/4h/D). Origin stays open (HOLD_BOTH) — test whether the technical hedge trigger preserves account vs realized loss.
Tighter hierarchy: (3m+15m+1h) AND ≥1 of (4h/D). Slower trigger — needs deeper momentum disagreement before hedging.
Looser: 3m AND ≥2 of (15m/1h/4h/D). Faster trigger — more hedge fires; tests whether early hedging is worth the extra trades.
